tools.name: place_cube
tools.title: Place Cube
tools.description: Places Cubes with explicit finite from/to. Non-zero rotation requires an explicit pivot. Supplied Group/Texture references must resolve uniquely before mutation. Success applies authored state only; visual/reference fidelity is not evaluated.

origin.description: Cube pivot [x,y,z]. Required for non-zero rotation; optional otherwise.
origin.markdownDescription: Cube pivot [x,y,z]. Required for non-zero rotation; optional otherwise.

rotation.description: Cube rotation in degrees [x,y,z]; non-zero rotation requires origin.
rotation.markdownDescription: Cube rotation in degrees [x,y,z]; non-zero rotation requires origin.

elements.description: Cubes to place. Each requires finite from/to; rotated Cubes also require origin.
elements.markdownDescription: Cubes to place. Each requires finite from/to; rotated Cubes also require origin.

texture.description: Optional Texture UUID, exact ID, or unique exact name; unresolved/ambiguous references fail.
texture.markdownDescription: Optional Texture UUID, exact ID, or unique exact name; unresolved/ambiguous references fail.

group.description: Optional Group UUID or unique exact name; omit/use `root` only for intentional root placement.
group.markdownDescription: Optional Group UUID or unique exact name; omit/use `root` only for intentional root placement.

anyOf.description: Unique Cube faces to apply the texture to.
anyOf.markdownDescription: Unique Cube faces to apply the texture to.

anyOf.description: Whether to apply the texture to all faces. Set to `true` to enable auto UV mapping.
anyOf.markdownDescription: Whether to apply the texture to all faces. Set to `true` to enable auto UV mapping.

face.description: Face to apply the texture to.
face.markdownDescription: Face to apply the texture to.

uv.description: Custom UV mapping for the face.
uv.markdownDescription: Custom UV mapping for the face.

anyOf.description: Unique Cube faces with custom UV mapping.
anyOf.markdownDescription: Unique Cube faces with custom UV mapping.

faces.description: Faces to apply the texture to. Set to `true` to enable auto UV mapping.
faces.markdownDescription: Faces to apply the texture to. Set to `true` to enable auto UV mapping.

tools.name: modify_cube
tools.title: Modify Cube
tools.description: Modifies one explicit Cube. UUID is preferred; an exact name must be unique and selection is never implicit. Origin-only uses pivot-transfer semantics; activating non-zero rotation requires origin. Returns before/after authored state and `geometry_effect`; visual/reference fidelity is not evaluated.

id.description: Required Cube UUID or unique exact name; selection is never an implicit target.
id.markdownDescription: Required Cube UUID or unique exact name; selection is never an implicit target.

origin.description: Cube pivot. Origin-only preserves visual position; with from/to/rotation it rewrites the authored transform.
origin.markdownDescription: Cube pivot. Origin-only preserves visual position; with from/to/rotation it rewrites the authored transform.

rotation.description: Cube rotation. Activating non-zero rotation requires origin; an already-rotated Cube may reuse its pivot.
rotation.markdownDescription: Cube rotation. Activating non-zero rotation requires origin; an already-rotated Cube may reuse its pivot.

autouv.description: Auto UV setting. 0 = disabled, 1 = enabled, 2 = relative auto UV.
autouv.markdownDescription: Auto UV setting. 0 = disabled, 1 = enabled, 2 = relative auto UV.

shade.description: Whether to apply shading to the cube.
shade.markdownDescription: Whether to apply shading to the cube.

color.description: Single digit to represent a color from a palette.
color.markdownDescription: Single digit to represent a color from a palette.

visibility.description: Whether the cube is visible or not.
visibility.markdownDescription: Whether the cube is visible or not.

tools.name: modify_cubes_batch
tools.title: Modify Cubes Batch
tools.description: Applies 1-32 explicit UUID-targeted Cube corrections in one recoverable Undo unit after full preflight. Origin-only preserves visual position; activating non-zero rotation requires origin. Returns per-Cube before/after state and `geometry_effect`. It performs no planning or visual judgement; success does not mean the geometry was corrected visually.

id.description: Exact Cube UUID; names and selection are not accepted for batch correction.
id.markdownDescription: Exact Cube UUID; names and selection are not accepted for batch correction.

origin.description: New pivot. Origin-only preserves visual position; with from/to/rotation it is an authored transform rewrite.
origin.markdownDescription: New pivot. Origin-only preserves visual position; with from/to/rotation it is an authored transform rewrite.

rotation.description: New rotation in degrees. Activating non-zero rotation requires origin; an already-rotated Cube may reuse its pivot.
rotation.markdownDescription: New rotation in degrees. Activating non-zero rotation requires origin; an already-rotated Cube may reuse its pivot.

updates.description: 1-32 explicit Cube transform/visibility updates applied in one Undo unit.
updates.markdownDescription: 1-32 explicit Cube transform/visibility updates applied in one Undo unit.

tools.name: capture_screenshot
tools.title: Capture Screenshot
tools.description: Returns the image data of the current editor view. This is a branch-only observation helper when that specific editor view carries evidence that canonical views cannot answer. For normal reference-driven geometry review, prefer `capture_model_views` so framing/orientation are deterministic.

tools.name: capture_app_screenshot
tools.title: Capture App Screenshot
tools.description: Source-preserved generic Blockbench full-application screenshot helper. It is disabled in the normal BlockIT Bedrock Entity surface; use `capture_model_views` or `capture_screenshot` for model evidence.

tools.name: set_camera_angle
tools.title: Set Camera Angle
tools.description: Source-preserved generic editor-camera mutation helper. It is disabled in the normal BlockIT Bedrock Entity surface because `capture_model_views` provides deterministic observation without mutating the active editor camera.

tools.name: capture_model_views
tools.title: Capture Model Views
tools.description: Captures 1-5 deterministic labeled 512×512 canonical model views without changing the active editor camera. Requires explicit front_direction and supports model or explicit-envelope framing. Returns observation images only; it does not compare, score, repair, or return PASS/FAIL.

views.description: One to five unique canonical model views to capture.
views.markdownDescription: One to five unique canonical model views to capture.

front_direction.description: Explicit object front direction established by the modelling coordinate frame. No default is used to avoid mirrored comparisons.
front_direction.markdownDescription: Explicit object front direction established by the modelling coordinate frame. No default is used to avoid mirrored comparisons.

tools.name: create_animation
tools.title: Create Animation
tools.description: Creates a new animation from Blockbench-authored transform values using the current Bedrock AnimationCodec.

animation_length.description: Optional finite animation length in seconds (0..10000).
animation_length.markdownDescription: Optional finite animation length in seconds (0..10000).

position.description: Authored Blockbench position [x,y,z]; converted internally to Bedrock file space.
position.markdownDescription: Authored Blockbench position [x,y,z]; converted internally to Bedrock file space.

rotation.description: Authored Blockbench rotation [x,y,z]; converted internally to Bedrock file space.
rotation.markdownDescription: Authored Blockbench rotation [x,y,z]; converted internally to Bedrock file space.

additionalProperties.description: Transform keyframes at finite non-negative times; one value per channel per time.
additionalProperties.markdownDescription: Transform keyframes at finite non-negative times; one value per channel per time.

bones.description: Bone keyframes keyed by Group UUID or case-insensitively unique Group name; transform values use Blockbench authored space.
bones.markdownDescription: Bone keyframes keyed by Group UUID or case-insensitively unique Group name; transform values use Blockbench authored space.

locator.description: Optional Locator name for the particle.
locator.markdownDescription: Optional Locator name for the particle.

bind_to_actor.description: Optional actor-binding flag; omit for native default.
bind_to_actor.markdownDescription: Optional actor-binding flag; omit for native default.

locator.description: Optional Locator name for the particle.
locator.markdownDescription: Optional Locator name for the particle.

bind_to_actor.description: Optional actor-binding flag; omit for native default.
bind_to_actor.markdownDescription: Optional actor-binding flag; omit for native default.

particle_effects.description: Particle effects keyed by unique finite non-negative timestamps; each value is one effect or a non-empty effect array.
particle_effects.markdownDescription: Particle effects keyed by unique finite non-negative timestamps; each value is one effect or a non-empty effect array.

tools.name: manage_keyframes
tools.title: Manage Keyframes
tools.description: Creates, deletes, edits, or selects explicit keyframe targets for one bone/channel. Edit omission preserves existing interpolation; non-create actions require each requested time to resolve uniquely before Undo/selection.

animation_id.description: Animation UUID or name. If not provided, uses current animation.
animation_id.markdownDescription: Animation UUID or name. If not provided, uses current animation.

bone_name.description: Exact Group UUID or exact unique Group name to manage keyframes for.
bone_name.markdownDescription: Exact Group UUID or exact unique Group name to manage keyframes for.

time.description: Finite non-negative keyframe time in seconds.
time.markdownDescription: Finite non-negative keyframe time in seconds.

values.description: Finite [x,y,z] values, or a finite uniform scalar.
values.markdownDescription: Finite [x,y,z] values, or a finite uniform scalar.

interpolation.description: Optional interpolation change. Omit on edit to preserve the existing interpolation.
interpolation.markdownDescription: Optional interpolation change. Omit on edit to preserve the existing interpolation.

bezier_handles.description: Finite per-axis Bezier handle offsets [x,y,z]; set interpolation=bezier when authoring handles.
bezier_handles.markdownDescription: Finite per-axis Bezier handle offsets [x,y,z]; set interpolation=bezier when authoring handles.

keyframes.description: One or more keyframes for the action; empty mutation/selection requests are rejected.
keyframes.markdownDescription: One or more keyframes for the action; empty mutation/selection requests are rejected.

tools.name: animation_graph_editor
tools.title: Animation Graph Editor
tools.description: Controls animation curves in the graph editor for fine-tuning animations.

animation_id.description: Animation UUID or name. If not provided, uses current animation.
animation_id.markdownDescription: Animation UUID or name. If not provided, uses current animation.

bone_name.description: Exact Group UUID or exact unique Group name to modify curves for.
bone_name.markdownDescription: Exact Group UUID or exact unique Group name to modify curves for.

axis.description: Bezier-handle axis to modify. 'all' applies the same handle change to x, y, and z; interpolation mode itself remains keyframe-level.
axis.markdownDescription: Bezier-handle axis to modify. 'all' applies the same handle change to x, y, and z; interpolation mode itself remains keyframe-level.

action.description: Type of curve modification to apply.
action.markdownDescription: Type of curve modification to apply.

keyframe_range.description: Time range to apply the curve modification. If not provided, applies to all keyframes.
keyframe_range.markdownDescription: Time range to apply the curve modification. If not provided, applies to all keyframes.

control_point_1.description: Left Bezier handle offset [time, value]; time must be <= 0.
control_point_1.markdownDescription: Left Bezier handle offset [time, value]; time must be <= 0.

control_point_2.description: Right Bezier handle offset [time, value]; time must be >= 0.
control_point_2.markdownDescription: Right Bezier handle offset [time, value]; time must be >= 0.

custom_curve.description: Custom Bezier left/right handle offsets for the requested axis or all axes (only for 'custom' action).
custom_curve.markdownDescription: Custom Bezier left/right handle offsets for the requested axis or all axes (only for 'custom' action).

tools.name: bone_rigging
tools.title: Bone Rigging
tools.description: Creates/edits Bedrock Group bones with explicit preflighted targets. Create/parent reject hierarchy cycles; create/rename/mirror enforce case-insensitive unique bone names; delete snapshots the subtree and affected animations. `set_pivot` needs origin, `mirror` needs an axis, and `set_ik` must author an IK change while target-only edits preserve enabled state. Missing/ambiguous targets fail before mutation.

action.description: Action to perform on the bone structure.
action.markdownDescription: Action to perform on the bone structure.

name.description: Create: new unique name. Other actions: Group UUID or unique exact name.
name.markdownDescription: Create: new unique name. Other actions: Group UUID or unique exact name.

new_name.description: New unique bone name required by the rename action.
new_name.markdownDescription: New unique bone name required by the rename action.

parent.description: Parent Group UUID or unique exact name; required by parent, optional on create.
parent.markdownDescription: Parent Group UUID or unique exact name; required by parent, optional on create.

origin.description: Pivot/origin; required by set_pivot. Omit on create unless a real joint/attachment needs it.
origin.markdownDescription: Pivot/origin; required by set_pivot. Omit on create unless a real joint/attachment needs it.

rotation.description: Initial create rotation; omit for neutral zero rotation.
rotation.markdownDescription: Initial create rotation; omit for neutral zero rotation.

children.description: Create-only child UUIDs or unique exact names; all are preflighted.
children.markdownDescription: Create-only child UUIDs or unique exact names; all are preflighted.

ik_enabled.description: Enable inverse kinematics for this bone.
ik_enabled.markdownDescription: Enable inverse kinematics for this bone.

ik_target.description: Existing target Group UUID or exact unique name for IK.
ik_target.markdownDescription: Existing target Group UUID or exact unique name for IK.

mirror_axis.description: Axis required by mirror; no implicit mirror axis is assumed.
mirror_axis.markdownDescription: Axis required by mirror; no implicit mirror axis is assumed.

tools.name: animation_timeline
tools.title: Animation Timeline
tools.description: Controls the animation timeline, including playback, time scrubbing, and timeline settings.

time.description: Time in seconds for set_time. Must be finite and within Blockbench Timeline.setTime() range 0..1000; it is not clamped to animation.length.
time.markdownDescription: Time in seconds for set_time. Must be finite and within Blockbench Timeline.setTime() range 0..1000; it is not clamped to animation.length.

length.description: Length in seconds for set_length. Must be finite and within Blockbench's 0..10000 input range; Animation.setLength() may raise the resulting length to the authored keyframe floor.
length.markdownDescription: Length in seconds for set_length. Must be finite and within Blockbench's 0..10000 input range; Animation.setLength() may raise the resulting length to the authored keyframe floor.

fps.description: Animation snapping rate in frames per second for set_fps; Blockbench supports 10 to 500.
fps.markdownDescription: Animation snapping rate in frames per second for set_fps; Blockbench supports 10 to 500.

start.description: Finite non-negative start time in seconds.
start.markdownDescription: Finite non-negative start time in seconds.

end.description: Finite non-negative end time in seconds.
end.markdownDescription: Finite non-negative end time in seconds.

tools.name: batch_keyframe_operations
tools.title: Batch Keyframe Operations
tools.description: Performs bounded batch keyframe operations and rejects incomplete/no-op requests plus offset/scale plans that would leave the native 0..10000 keyframe-time range; scale also rejects selected-keyframe time collapse before Undo.

interval.description: Finite positive time interval between keyframes.
interval.markdownDescription: Finite positive time interval between keyframes.

offset.description: Finite time offset for the pattern.
offset.markdownDescription: Finite time offset for the pattern.

scale_factor.description: Finite scale factor for keyframe time.
scale_factor.markdownDescription: Finite scale factor for keyframe time.

bake_interval.description: Strictly positive finite interval in seconds for baking keyframes.
bake_interval.markdownDescription: Strictly positive finite interval in seconds for baking keyframes.

tools.name: animation_copy_paste
tools.title: Animation Copy/Paste
tools.description: Copies/pastes animation data with action-specific source/target preflight. Copy requires matching keyframes; paste rejects an empty clipboard and invalid or internally colliding snapped times; `mirror_paste` requires an explicit axis. Existing-target overwrite keeps native paste behavior.

bone.description: Exact source Group UUID or exact unique Group name.
bone.markdownDescription: Exact source Group UUID or exact unique Group name.

channels.description: One or more animation channels to copy.
channels.markdownDescription: One or more animation channels to copy.

time_range.description: Time range to copy. If not provided, copies all keyframes.
time_range.markdownDescription: Time range to copy. If not provided, copies all keyframes.

bone.description: Exact target Group UUID or exact unique Group name.
bone.markdownDescription: Exact target Group UUID or exact unique Group name.

time_offset.description: Finite time offset for pasted keyframes.
time_offset.markdownDescription: Finite time offset for pasted keyframes.

mirror_axis.description: Axis to mirror across for mirror_paste.
mirror_axis.markdownDescription: Axis to mirror across for mirror_paste.

tools.name: inspect_animation
tools.title: Inspect Authored Animation
tools.description: Returns read-only Animation identity/settings plus bone and particle summaries. Supply `bone` for detailed transform keyframes; set `include_effect_keyframes=true` only when full particle-effect timing/data is needed. UUID is preferred; explicit names must be unique.

animation_id.description: Exact Animation UUID or exact unique Animation name. If omitted, uses the currently selected Animation.
animation_id.markdownDescription: Exact Animation UUID or exact unique Animation name. If omitted, uses the currently selected Animation.

bone.description: Optional Group UUID or unique exact name. Omit for animation/bone summaries; provide for detailed authored keyframes.
bone.markdownDescription: Optional Group UUID or unique exact name. Omit for animation/bone summaries; provide for detailed authored keyframes.

include_effect_keyframes.description: Include full particle-effect keyframes. Keep false for the normal summary path; enable only when effect timing/data is needed.
include_effect_keyframes.markdownDescription: Include full particle-effect keyframes. Keep false for the normal summary path; enable only when effect timing/data is needed.

tools.name: remove_element
tools.title: Remove Element
tools.description: Removes one explicit outliner element or Group target. UUID is resolved first; exact names must be unique. Group removal follows native recursive subtree deletion and captures the deleted subtree plus affected animation state in one Undo edit.

id.description: Exact element UUID or exact unique name. Ambiguous names are rejected before removal.
id.markdownDescription: Exact element UUID or exact unique name. Ambiguous names are rejected before removal.

tools.name: add_group
tools.title: Add Group
tools.description: Adds a Group with neutral pivot/rotation defaults. Optional explicit parent must resolve uniquely before mutation; use non-zero pivot/rotation only for a real joint/attachment/transform reason.

origin.description: Group pivot/origin; omit for organizational Groups unless a joint/attachment needs it.
origin.markdownDescription: Group pivot/origin; omit for organizational Groups unless a joint/attachment needs it.

rotation.description: Initial Group rotation; omit for neutral zero rotation.
rotation.markdownDescription: Initial Group rotation; omit for neutral zero rotation.

parent.description: Parent Group UUID or unique exact name; omit/use `root` for intentional root.
parent.markdownDescription: Parent Group UUID or unique exact name; omit/use `root` for intentional root.

autouv.description: Auto UV setting. 0 = disabled, 1 = enabled, 2 = relative auto UV.
autouv.markdownDescription: Auto UV setting. 0 = disabled, 1 = enabled, 2 = relative auto UV.

tools.name: list_outline
tools.title: List Outline
tools.description: Returns a bounded hierarchical Cube/Group outline. Use `include_cubes=false` for a group-only skeleton; `max_depth` limits depth and `max_nodes` limits total returned nodes. Truncation is reported so targeted search can continue without dumping the whole project.

include_cubes.description: If true, include cubes as leaves. If false, return groups only.
include_cubes.markdownDescription: If true, include cubes as leaves. If false, return groups only.

max_depth.description: Maximum tree depth to traverse. Use a small value to summarize large projects.
max_depth.markdownDescription: Maximum tree depth to traverse. Use a small value to summarize large projects.

max_nodes.description: Maximum Cube/Group nodes returned. Increase only when a larger hierarchy is actually needed; use targeted search when truncated.
max_nodes.markdownDescription: Maximum Cube/Group nodes returned. Increase only when a larger hierarchy is actually needed; use targeted search when truncated.

tools.name: duplicate_element
tools.title: Duplicate Element
tools.description: Duplicates one explicit Cube/Group by UUID or unique exact name, with optional offset/name. Use only for established repetition/symmetry; duplication is not a shortcut for deciding primary geometry.

id.description: Exact Cube or Group UUID, or exact unique name. Ambiguous names are rejected before duplication.
id.markdownDescription: Exact Cube or Group UUID, or exact unique name. Ambiguous names are rejected before duplication.

tools.name: rename_element
tools.title: Rename Element
tools.description: Renames one explicit outliner element or Group target. UUID is resolved first; an exact name is accepted only when unique. Ambiguous names fail before mutation.

id.description: Exact outliner element or Group UUID, or exact unique name. Ambiguous names are rejected before rename.
id.markdownDescription: Exact outliner element or Group UUID, or exact unique name. Ambiguous names are rejected before rename.

tools.name: find_elements_by_criteria
tools.title: Find Elements by Criteria
tools.description: Read-only Cube/Group search by name, type, parent scope, size range, or selection. Explicit parent scope must resolve uniquely; invalid regex is rejected. Returns metadata only.

name_pattern.description: Optional case-sensitive name regex; invalid/oversized/unsafe patterns are rejected.
name_pattern.markdownDescription: Optional case-sensitive name regex; invalid/oversized/unsafe patterns are rejected.

name_contains.description: Substring to match element names. Case-insensitive.
name_contains.markdownDescription: Substring to match element names. Case-insensitive.

type.description: Restrict to Cube or Group results.
type.markdownDescription: Restrict to Cube or Group results.

parent_group.description: Optional parent Group UUID or unique exact name.
parent_group.markdownDescription: Optional parent Group UUID or unique exact name.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.
limit.markdownDescription: Maximum number of results to return.

tools.name: select_all_of_type
tools.title: Select All of Type
tools.description: Selection helper for workflows that require editor selection, mainly texture/Paint. It is not a normal geometry-targeting path; use explicit identities for geometry. Optional parent scope must resolve uniquely.

add_to_selection.description: If true, add to current selection. If false, replace Cube/Group selection.
add_to_selection.markdownDescription: If true, add to current selection. If false, replace Cube/Group selection.

parent_group.description: Exact parent Group UUID or exact unique name. Omit for no parent scope. Ambiguous or missing explicit scopes are rejected before selection changes.
parent_group.markdownDescription: Exact parent Group UUID or exact unique name. Omit for no parent scope. Ambiguous or missing explicit scopes are rejected before selection changes.

tools.name: filter_by_material
tools.title: Filter Elements by Material
tools.description: Returns a bounded list of Cubes that reference one explicit texture. Texture identity resolves UUID/ID/unique exact name; matching face keys are optional and truncation is reported only when an additional match exists. Read-only; it does not activate, paint, or mutate textures.

texture.description: Explicit texture reference for read-only Cube material discovery. UUID is preferred, then exact texture ID, then exact name only when unique. Ambiguous IDs or names are rejected.
texture.markdownDescription: Explicit texture reference for read-only Cube material discovery. UUID is preferred, then exact texture ID, then exact name only when unique. Ambiguous IDs or names are rejected.

include_face_keys.description: Include the list of cube face keys (e.g., 'north') that reference the texture.
include_face_keys.markdownDescription: Include the list of cube face keys (e.g., 'north') that reference the texture.

tools.name: get_selection
tools.title: Get Selection
tools.description: Returns current Cube/Group selection plus active Texture. Normal geometry inspection and mutation should prefer explicit UUIDs and focused inspection; use this only when editor selection state matters.

tools.name: inspect_element
tools.title: Inspect Authored Element
tools.description: Returns focused read-only authored state for one explicit Bedrock Cube, Group, Locator, or Null Object. UUID is preferred and exact names must be unique. Includes the type-specific transform, parent, and visibility state needed for precise correction; it does not modify selection/model state or return visual PASS/FAIL.

id.description: Exact Cube, Group, Locator, or Null Object UUID, or exact unique name. Prefer UUID after locating the element with the relevant discovery tool.
id.markdownDescription: Exact Cube, Group, Locator, or Null Object UUID, or exact unique name. Prefer UUID after locating the element with the relevant discovery tool.

tools.name: list_locator_elements
tools.title: List Bedrock Locator Elements
tools.description: Lists authored Locator and Null Object elements in the active Minecraft Bedrock Entity project with identity, type, and parent Group. Use inspect_element for their detailed authored state.

tools.name: manage_locator
tools.title: Manage Bedrock Locator
tools.description: Creates or updates a native Minecraft Bedrock Entity Locator under an explicit Group/bone. Create owns name, position, rotation, and ignore_inherited_scale. Update resolves the Locator UUID first, otherwise an exact name must be unique. Parent targets are preflighted before Undo. Rename/delete remain owned by rename_element/remove_element.

parent.description: Required parent Group UUID or exact unique Group name.
parent.markdownDescription: Required parent Group UUID or exact unique Group name.

id.description: Exact Locator UUID or exact unique Locator name.
id.markdownDescription: Exact Locator UUID or exact unique Locator name.

parent.description: Optional replacement parent Group UUID or exact unique Group name.
parent.markdownDescription: Optional replacement parent Group UUID or exact unique Group name.

tools.name: manage_null_object
tools.title: Manage Bedrock Null Object
tools.description: Creates or updates a Blockbench Null Object used by the Bedrock Entity workflow. Bedrock geometry serialization round-trips it through a `_null_` locator entry, while IK fields remain Blockbench editor/animation state and are intentionally read-only in this minimum slice. Parent targets are preflighted before Undo. Rename/delete remain owned by rename_element/remove_element.

parent.description: Required parent Group UUID or exact unique Group name.
parent.markdownDescription: Required parent Group UUID or exact unique Group name.

id.description: Exact Null Object UUID or exact unique Null Object name.
id.markdownDescription: Exact Null Object UUID or exact unique Null Object name.

parent.description: Optional replacement parent Group UUID or exact unique Group name.
parent.markdownDescription: Optional replacement parent Group UUID or exact unique Group name.

tools.name: list_export_formats
tools.title: List BlockIT Model Outputs
tools.description: Lists the model outputs intentionally exposed by BlockIT for an active Bedrock Entity project: native Bedrock geometry JSON (`bedrock`) and editable Blockbench project (`project`). It does not enumerate arbitrary registered Blockbench codecs. Bedrock animation files/controllers use Blockbench's separate AnimationCodec surface and are not represented as generic model codecs here.

tools.name: export_model
tools.title: Export Bedrock Model
tools.description: Compiles the active Bedrock Entity project as Bedrock geometry JSON or editable `.bbmodel`; optional filesystem write requires Blockbench permission. Other model codecs are rejected.

codec_id.description: BlockIT model output: `bedrock` for Minecraft Bedrock geometry JSON, or `project` for the editable Blockbench `.bbmodel`.
codec_id.markdownDescription: BlockIT model output: `bedrock` for Minecraft Bedrock geometry JSON, or `project` for the editable Blockbench `.bbmodel`.

options.description: Optional compile options for the selected Bedrock/project codec.
options.markdownDescription: Optional compile options for the selected Bedrock/project codec.

path.description: Optional absolute output path; requires Blockbench filesystem permission.
path.markdownDescription: Optional absolute output path; requires Blockbench filesystem permission.

max_content_length.description: Maximum characters returned in `content`. Defaults to 0 when `path` is supplied, otherwise 100000; set explicitly when both file write and returned content are needed.
max_content_length.markdownDescription: Maximum characters returned in `content`. Defaults to 0 when `path` is supplied, otherwise 100000; set explicitly when both file write and returned content are needed.

tools.name: undo
tools.title: Undo
tools.description: Undoes the most recent edit in the current project. Use `steps` to undo multiple edits in a single call. Returns the action(s) that were undone.

tools.name: redo
tools.title: Redo
tools.description: Redoes the most recently undone edit. Use `steps` to redo multiple edits in a single call. Returns the action(s) that were redone.

tools.name: get_undo_stack
tools.title: Get Undo Stack
tools.description: Returns the current undo/redo history and named checkpoints. Use this for recovery/navigation when the workflow actually needs to undo or return to a checkpoint; it is not a normal modelling-observation step and should not be polled between successful bounded edits.

limit.description: Maximum number of entries to return (most recent first).
limit.markdownDescription: Maximum number of entries to return (most recent first).

tools.name: save_checkpoint
tools.title: Save Checkpoint
tools.description: Inserts a named marker into the undo history for meaningful risky multi-step rework or a valuable recovery boundary. Do not create a checkpoint after every Cube/edit; normal bounded edits already participate in Blockbench Undo. The marker can later be located with `get_undo_stack`. Does not modify model geometry.

name.description: Descriptive name for the checkpoint. Shown in undo history so agents can navigate back to this point.
name.markdownDescription: Descriptive name for the checkpoint. Shown in undo history so agents can navigate back to this point.

tools.name: from_geo_json
tools.title: Import GeoJSON
tools.description: Imports a model from a GeoJSON file.

geojson.description: Path to the GeoJSON file or data URL, or the GeoJSON string itself.
geojson.markdownDescription: Path to the GeoJSON file or data URL, or the GeoJSON string itself.

tools.name: get_face_material_instances
tools.title: Get Face Material Instances
tools.description: Gets material-instance metadata from Bedrock cube faces. Blockbench's Bedrock geometry codec preserves this field on per-face UV data.

cube_id.description: Exact Cube UUID or exact unique Cube name. If omitted, uses the first selected Cube.
cube_id.markdownDescription: Exact Cube UUID or exact unique Cube name. If omitted, uses the first selected Cube.

faces.description: Specific non-empty face set to get/clear. If omitted, uses all faces.
